(1) The tech-spec says 'jjwt dependency removed from build.gradle' (Decision 1 rationale) — jjwt was NEVER in build.gradle, so this is a false claim about an active removal. The remaining claims about existing files (SecurityConfig.java, application.properties, docker-compose.yml with correct MongoDB 8.0 and Redis 7.4 images, .env.example) are all verified. Claims about what needs to be ADDED are correctly framed as new additions.
